title: AntiUtils
description: Adds a few features to improve SMP Gameplay
body:
AntiUtils
Client-side Fabric utility mod for Minecraft 1.21.11.

Features
- Reveal invisible players
- Reveal invisible animals
- Optional blue tint for revealed invisible entities
- Player-name autocomplete for /invsee and /ecsee
- In-game toggle GUI
- Right Shift or /antiutils opens the AntiUtils GUI
